ERR-II-001.mechanical_failure_mode: One or more technician-entered values (RPM, displacement, cylinder count, emission category, fuel type, or sensor configuration) are inconsistent with measured gas chemistry and vehicle specifications.
ui_remediation_steps: Verify all technician-entered values against the vehicle VIN decode and under-hood labels.
Re-enter any values that disagree with vehicle specifications.
Check that the correct engine family, fuel type, and emission category are selected.
Re-run the diagnostic session with corrected inputs.
If chemistry remains inconsistent, flag for senior technician review.
